title: East Fork Campground & Horse Hotel

services.name: Campsite
services.desc: Nestled amidst acres of enchanting, forested mountains and crystal-clear streams, East Fork Campground and Horse Hotel offers a unique environment for camping buffs. This picturesque park boasts a myriad of facilities, including clean and updated bathhouses, a primitive cabin, pavilion, playground, picnic sites, trailer parking, a camp store, and, of course, the beautiful Greenbrier River. However, what sets East Fork Campground and Horse Hotel apart and makes it a haven for equestrian enthusiasts are the campground sites with stable facilities, offering a perfect retreat for horse lovers seeking a memorable and immersive outdoor experience.
